name: GS1 Web Vocabulary
status: Version 1.18: the ontology carries owl:versionInfo "1.18" and dct:modified 2026-06-01, and the archive on ref.gs1.org lists version 1.18.0 published 2026-06-01. A ratification label with a date for 1.18 is not found in the pages read, and the newest entry of the change log is 1.17.0 (2026-11-09).
relevance: The vocabulary "is designed as an extension to schema.org" and defines parties and a product offer; gs1:Product, gs1:Offer and gs1:Organization carry skos:exactMatch mappings to the schema.org terms of the same name, and gs1:gtin to schema:gtin14. It also holds the link types used in GS1 Digital Link, under the namespace https://ref.gs1.org/voc/, with data in JSON-LD and Turtle and JSON-LD context files that the landing page labels "provisional".

evidence.read: On 2026-11-09, on ref.gs1.org: the landing page /voc/ ("New terms are developed and ratified according to the Global Standards Management Process"; "JSON-LD context resources (provisional)"), the ontology gs1Voc.jsonld (header: owl:versionInfo "1.18", dct:modified 2026-06-01, dct:issued 2017-11-20, voaf:extends, voaf:specializes and voaf:hasEquivalencesWith schema:; description: "The vocabulary builds on and refers to schema.org where appropriate."), the archive page ("Version 1.18.0 Published 2026-06-01") and changeLog.json (newest entry 1.17.0).
evidence.not_read: Not read: gs1Voc.ttl, the two JSON-LD context files (data/GS1-WebVoc-context.jsonld, data/GS1-core-context.jsonld), and www.gs1.org (it refuses this map's reader).
